comments.text: The Caribbean is like a book everyone thinks they've already read because of the beaches, then this documentary opens the hidden chapters. Beyond the turquoise water are mountains, forests, history, and communities with incredible stories. Meanwhile, my vacation plans usually end at the nearest beach chair.
